newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed this week on 98,800 head including 22,800 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Most feedlots sold this week's supplies. Bids and asking prices not well established Friday, last sales Thursday, April 17 at $68.00 per cwt. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
